sources.note: Nothing. Samosa = C13 (346-item list + pronoun/affix table p. 167). Intro sec. 6 (p. viii): 'The transcription is semi-phonemic; i.e. apparently non-contrastive phonetic details are omitted and fluctuating sounds were transcribed consistently only when discovered early enough' -- discusses stop voicing, labio-velars, nasalised vowels, per-language fluctuations (Samosa not listed); no word 'stress', 'accent' or 'tone' anywhere.
